title: Why we are adding Redis to the catalog service

messages.speaker: Priya Raman
messages.content: Catalog p95 latency hit 1.8s during the last load test. Almost all of it is repeated PostgreSQL reads of the same product rows.

messages.speaker: Marcus Lee
messages.content: Agree. A cache in front of nova-catalog is the cheapest fix. Redis is already approved by security, so no new vendor review.

messages.speaker: Elena Petrova
messages.content: What TTL do we start with? Product data changes a few times a day.

messages.speaker: Marcus Lee
messages.content: Let's start with 300 seconds and tune from metrics. I'll open TKT-101.

messages.speaker: Priya Raman
messages.content: Decision: introduce Redis as a catalog cache, initial TTL 300s.
